hook.text: 52 minutes about Yusuf. Not one du’a for him.

verses.text: “Do not despair of the mercy of Allah.”

end.text: 52 minutes about him. And for him?
end.gold: This afternoon: one du’a for the one you talked about. By name.

captions: Saturday, 6:10 p.m. The market. Your phone buzzes.
“Café. Usual table. You won’t believe what Yusuf did.”
Mint tea. Three friends. One story, told again and again.
You laugh. You add one too. It wasn’t even true.
Then your phone lights up. It’s him.
“Brother, my mum has surgery tomorrow. Make du’a for her?”
After Fajr. The river is still. You say his name, in a du’a.
“Ya Allah, heal his mother. And forgive my tongue.”
Then one message to him: “I’m with you, brother.”
52 minutes against him. 1 minute for him. Start there.
